    <li>Global Historical Climatology Network (NOAA)</li>
      <ul>
        <li>Pros:</li>
          <ul>
            <li>Simple formatting</li>
            <li>Data ranges from 1959-2025</li>
          </ul>
        <li>Cons:</li>
          <ul>
            <li>Modest spatial, temporal resolution</li>
            <li>(Weather station points, day-aggregated data)</li>
            <li>Only precip. totals, and max/min temperatures</li>
          </ul>
      </ul>
  </ul>
